title: Survival to the MAX
body:
A realistic version of Minecraft in all its glory! Ride on the see, explore the dangers of the cave! Explore the beautiful landscapes and biomes! Take in the breathtaking mountains with beautiful shaders. Although you need a pretty good pc, but that shouldnt stop you from seeing the beautiful version of minecraft. You'll atleast need 16gb of ram, a 4070 or the amd equivalent a ryzen 7700 or the intel equivalent.

________________________________________________________________________________________________
I reccommend allocating 8gb of ram or more.
